notes.title: Bay Side DLC is Out Now!
notes.content:
Get ready to dive back into the action, the Bay Side expansion for Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator is now available!

This new DLC brings a fresh wave of high-stakes challenges, taking you to a whole new district and pushing your paramedic skills to the limit. Whether you’re navigating tight streets or responding to a large-scale catastrophe, Bay Side has everything to test your reflexes, decision-making, and courage.

[previewyoutube=V_ozB26mQWA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]What’s new in Bay Side?[/h1]
[b]🗺 New District[/b]
Explore the Belhill district, a dynamic new area with its own set of environments, emergencies, and challenges.

[b]🚨 New Callouts[/b]
Face intense new emergency situations that demand quick thinking and calm under pressure. A social media challenge takes a dangerous turn. New VR headsets are causing crash accidents. And more!

[b]🌪 New Catastrophic Event[/b]
Take on a large-scale disaster scenario where every second can make the difference between life and death.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3140840/Ambulance_Life__Bay_Side_Expansion/

notes.title: 🛠️Ambulance Life Patch | 2025-04-09
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Medics! [u]Patch 1.4[/u] is now live![/h3]

[h3][i]Check out the details below![/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/0d5b0b89477ddb419c3de85046b153d1b3316a19.png[/img]

[h2]⚠️ We Need Your Help![/h2]
We are always listening closely to community feedback, but as we make any significant changes, there may be still players who have unique cases that need special care.

If even after installing all patches you are still experiencing crashes, freezes, and black screens, [u][b]we need your help to find direct solutions for your problems.[/b][/u]

Please follow this link to get us your specific details so we can investigate solutions for your case here:
[u][b][url=https://my.nacongaming.com/en-US/support/game/ambulance]https://my.nacongaming.com/en-US/support/game/ambulance[/url][/b][/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]🦠 Bugs & Technical Improvements[/h3]
The Swift Aid Siren’s brightness has been fixed
[list][*] Fixed floating blood puddles
[*] Fixed floating props in callouts
[*] Fixed camera transition at vehicle start
[*] Fixed holes in buildings
[*] Fixed additional bus spawning in car crash callout
[*] Fixed flickering skid marks
[*] Fixed broken ventilation material in mall
[*] Fixed clipping patient in Catastrophic Event 02 [spoiler](The Burning Mall)[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed Muscle cramping Animation
[*] Fixed the Partner’s suddenly disappearing hair
[*] Fixed a bug where District unlocks would appear multiple times in the shift selection screen
[*] The ambulance will no longer spawn on the roofs of cars when loading the last checkpoint
[*] The “Panic Attack Training Callout“ will now correctly prompt you to use Lorazepam instead of Ketamine
[*] You partner will no longer ask you to apply Glucose if the patient is suffering from Cardiac Arrest
[*] Fixed "soft-blocking" dropdown input when using the back action
[*] Fixed locked diagnosis entries when loading into an old save game shift
[*] Fixed a bug where multiple dispatcher voices would be played simultaneously[/list]
[h3]🧪 Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Added additional Tooltips to the Scoring screen to provide more context on why a certain score was achieved
[*] Increased the range of the siren’s effect on traffic to prevent cars from moving into the rescue lane
[*] Pedestrians will now put in more effort to avoid the ambulance
[*] You will now receive a prompt to reset your ambulance if it gets stuck on terrain
[*] Lowered the chance that a callout spawns far away in the distance
[*] Any patients that are not selected for treatment will now receive a marker indicating that another ambulance will pick them up afterwards
[*] The “End Shift” prompt will now appear much faster after ending your final callout
[*] Added jolts: Crashing into obstacles while transporting patients can now cause several different Injuries
[*] Added additional useful hints to the loading screen
[*] Made acceleration adaptive trigger much lighter
[*] Added CPR handling for heart alarm display
[*] Minor performance improvements
[*] Updated recommendation for “third degree burns” to “burn dressings”
[*] Added variable size for the transport event HUD
[*] Significantly reduced the freakiness of our cables
[*] Bleeding patients will now have growing blood patches on their clothes
[*] Significant improvements to cutscene quality and ensured that the cutscene will play at a stable FPS
[*] Implemented shift result background images
[*] Fixed the missing District highlighting in the map screen
[*] Improved our physical blood simulation
[*] Brightened the dark corner within the “Bleeding” tutorial
[*] Added near distance fade for gates in the District 2 hospital
[*] Added a volume slider for the siren
[*] The partner will only snap at you if you actually hurt the patient while driving[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]📆 What’s Next?[/h2]
We are setting our sights on the [b]Bayside Expansion[/b] release on April 22nd, so please stay tuned here and our official Discord for all the latest news and updates.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and experiences with us as we continue to address community concerns. Thank you for helping us continue shape Ambulance Life into the best version of itself it can be! ❤️

notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Medics! [u]Patch 1.3[/u] is now live![/h3]

[h3][i]Check out the details below![/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/0d5b0b89477ddb419c3de85046b153d1b3316a19.png[/img]

[h2]📡 Live Stream Event[/h2]
Aesir Interactive will be live on [u][b][url=https://twitch.tv/AesirInteractive]Twitch[/url][/b][/u] and [u][b][url=https://youtube.com/@AesirInteractiv]YouTube[/url][/b][/u] to play Ambulance Life while discussing the recent patches, community feedback, and the future of the project!

We will start the stream live in Munich, Germany on [b]Thursday, March 6th[/b] from [b]08:00 PST / 17:00 CET[/b] so mark those calendars!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]⚠️ We Need Your Help![/h2]
We are listening extremely closely to community feedback, but as we make sweeping changes, there may be still players who have unique cases that need special care.

If even after installing the last three technical patches, you are still experiencing crashes, freezes, and black screens, [b][u]we need specific files from your computer to find direct solutions for your problems.[/u][/b]

Please follow the instructions from this link to get us your specific files so we can investigate solutions for your case here:

[u][b]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926520/discussions/2/595140258825306737/[/b][/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]🦠 [u]Bugs & Technical Improvements[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiple Crash Fixes.
[*] Significantly reduced the likelihood of our NPC Cars bouncing around randomly.
[*] Cars will no longer crash into Callout Scenes.
[*] Fixed a bug where the driving camera snaps back after a manual reset.
[*] Fixed several Instances where patient’s arms would clip into their sides.
[*] Fixed Several Visual Issues with our Callout Assets.
[*] Fixed Several Visual Issues with our World Assets.
[*] Fixed Several Issues where patient’s arms would be twisted.
[*] Fixed a Bug where you could get stuck on the First Shift.
[*] Fixed several markings on the highway which were pointing in the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed flickering UI.
[*] Removed several invisible Barriers.
[*] Fixed a Bug in the Introductory Shift where the Partner refused to exit the Ambulance.
[*] Removed Hospital Markers that are in locked districts.
[*] Reduced the odds of the stretcher getting stuck on the Ambulance Door.
[*] Fixed the Parking Assist Sounds.
[*] The patient Protocol Body Temperate will now always correctly be in the unit that the player has selected.
[*] Deactivated another Cactus collision. (lol)
[*] Fixed a wrong icon being shown upon unlocking the glucometer.
[*] Fixed build ID showing twice in the splash screen.
[*] Fixed a flaw in the parking validation and adjusted the colliders on the ambulances.
[*] Fixed white placeholder Icons.
[*] Fixed flickering Skid Marks.
[*] Fixed Anamnesis Camera Positions in Catastrophic Event 01 [spoiler](The Freeway Catastrophe)[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed several floating Assets.
[*] Fixed floating stretcher in Cutscenes.
[*] Fixed the Lighting in the Customization Scene.
[*] Fixed further Glass Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 [spoiler](The Burning Mall)[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed Railings Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 [spoiler](The Burning Mall)[/spoiler].
[*] Improved performance on Lower Graphics Settings.
[*] Added an automatic HDD/SSD detection.
[*] More PSO Caching: Reduced the amount of lag spikes, especially on High and Ultra Settings. This will cause the initial loading screen after downloading the patch for the first time to be a bit longer.
[*] Significantly Improved overall Visuals through due to the activation of Ambient Occlusion and Global Illumination (Also for Consoles):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/0dfc7cf49794de7ceb23037a9c7e2c66663a6dce.png[/img][i][h3]BEFORE UPDATE (High Graphics settings)[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/96f0e907b436eab0d573c6406c2ea3904c3cc437.png[/img][i][h3]AFTER UPDATE (High Graphics settings)[/h3][/i]

[*] Enabled traffic density setting on consoles.
[*] Enabled video settings tab on consoles to be able to tune the following Settings:
[list][*] Brightness/Gamma
[*] HDR settings
[*] UI scaling
[*] Color Blind settings
[*] Toggle Motion Blur
[*] Toggle Bloom
[*] Toggle Lens Flare
[*] Toggle Depth of Field[/list][*]Updated Lighting to not have overly blueish tone in shadowed areas.
[*] Improved Main Menu Layout and UI.
[*] Selected Tools will no longer remain in your hand and clip through the screen when opening the patient Protocol.
[*] Disabled NVidia Frame Generation by default to prevent UI artifacts and screen tearing. [b]These can be re-enabled for a performance Boost![/b]
[*] Enabled text wrapping in several handbook elements.[/list]
[h3]🧪 [u]Quality of Life Improvements[/u][/h3]
[list][*] Removed duplicate Evidence from the Handbook 
[*] Added some additional Feedback for when Patients went into Ventricular Fibrillation:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/8e2451e19f5934407da009a87474ba9d68a5ab7f.png[/img]
[*] Simulation Mode will now additionally deactivate the following guidance Features:
[list][*] The patient Protocol will no longer directly tell you which clues point to which Diagnosis Options by providing red/green ratings.
[*] The Recommended Treatment steps after selecting a Diagnosis will no longer be shown in the Treatment HUD.
[*] Players will no longer be able to load the Last Checkpoint after going Game Over.[/list][*] Balanced the Callout Director to more evenly distribute our different callouts.
[*] Reduced maximum waiting time for next callout from 50s to 30s.
[*] Switching patient from a police officer to a homeless person in training callout 03.
[*] Added an automatic Discovery for very close patients.
[*] Catastrophic Events will now Trigger even when approached from the wrong side.
[*] Increased the Odds of Preexisting Conditions to appear on patients.
[*] Increased the maximum Output of the Thermostat to 98°F/37°C.
[*] Patients will now change their skin color a bit more slowly when their body temperature changes.
[*] Slightly reduced patient’s base blood sugar consumption.
[*] Added an Option to Invert X and Invert Y Axis.
[*] Added Advanced Tooltips to our Tools which briefly summarize their effect:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/de23515575e62fcf3c20bfd1cf86128f0cca6ac9.png[/img]
[*] Added a Reset to Default Button to our menus.
[*] Added additional Player Guidance Recommendations to the Callout Overview UI.
[*] We will now Highlight Life Saving measures if appropriate Evidence has been discovered.[/list]
[h3]🚧 [u]Known Issues[/u][/h3]
[list][*] Scoring Screen may not be initialized properly after a Tutorial Mission.
[*] Switching between different menus in the Customization Settings may temporarily remove hair from characters.[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]📆 What’s Next?[/h2]
We are evaluating our next steps as we gear up another major patch this month and the Bayside Expansion release next month, so please stay tuned here and our official Discord for all the latest news and updates.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and experiences with us as we continue to pushing for these sweeping updates to address your concerns. Thank you for helping us continue shape Ambulance Life into the best version of itself it can be! ❤️

notes.content:

[h3][i]Check out the details below![/i][/h3]

We will start the stream live in Munich, Germany on [b]Tuesday, February 25th[/b] from [b]09:00 PST / 18:00 CET[/b] so mark those calendars!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]⚠️ We Need Your Help![/h2]
We are listening extremely closely to community feedback, but as we make sweeping changes, there may be still players who have unique cases that need special care.

[u][b]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1926520/discussions/2/595140258825306737/[/b][/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]🦠 [u]Bugs & Technical Improvements[/u][/h3]
[list][*]Improved PSO Precaching: We fixed an issue where players would experience severe Lag when starting the game for the First time. [b]After downloading the patch, the first loading screen is expected to be prolonged for that one initial time.[/b]
[*]Multiple Crash Fixes.
[*]Added a failsafe for save game corruption that can occur if the game crashes while autosaving.
[*]Fixed a Bug where the post-callout summary screen would have “UNSELECTED” as the recommended Diagnosis Option.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented players from entering the ambulance side door during the Treatment Phase.
[*]Fixed faulty Settings for Foliage and View Distance.
[*]Removed some invisible collisions.
[*]Fixed some NPCs getting stuck on callout props.
[*]Fixed Glass Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 [spoiler](The Burning Mall)[/spoiler].
[*]Fixed Fire Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 [spoiler](The Burning Mall)[/spoiler].
[*]Consoles Only: Fixed a bug that caused the wheels of NPVs to stop turning.[/list]
[h3]🧪 [u]Quality of Life Improvements[/u][/h3]
[list][*]We improved the Patient Protocol to show which Diagnoses are not unlocked yet. You will unlock more of these diagnoses by naturally progressing through the game and leveling up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/c5224f0d9b9ad85efdf445e5aedbb891fb70393f.png[/img]
[*]Callout Director: We significantly reduced the likelihood of the same callout triggering multiple times in a row and also increased the chances of callouts spawning in your shift’s starting district. (It is still possible for Callouts to spawn in neighboring Districts). Additionally, if a new Callout type has been unlocked, then this Callout type is always guaranteed to spawn in the next shift. 
[*]Increased the speed of new Unlocks during earlier Levels.
[*]The Game will now be paused when you open the Handbook.
[*]Changed the Layout of the Waterfront HQ base to make it less likely to be boxed in by traffic when a new shift starts.
[*]Reduced the number of Delivery Trucks in the City.
[*]Added a “Reset to Default” Button to the Settings menu.
[*]Added an info Box to Game Over Screens informing players that they can change the Game Over settings.
[*]Made the Partner less chatty during Treatment.
[*]Difficulty for Catastrophic events has been adjusted for slightly easier S-Scores.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]📆 What’s Next?[/h2]
We look forward to delivering the next phase of major updates in the coming weeks, so please stay tuned here and our official Discord for all the latest news and updates.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and experiences with us as we continue to pushing for these sweeping updates to address your concerns. Thank you for helping us continue shape Ambulance Life into the best version of itself it can be! ❤️

Hello Paramedics,

🚑 Ambulance Life is finally here! A huge thank you for all your feedback. Your input helps us improve the game, and thanks to it, we’re bringing you the first patch.

The team has been working hard to deliver a first patch addressing key issues. This patch brings significant improvements to gameplay, visuals, and overall performance. We've improved emergency callouts, improved patient interactions, and made the experience smoother and more immersive... 

[h1]TL;DR[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Performance & Stability[/b] - Updated XeSS & DLSS settings, enabled ray tracing with Lumen, and optimized game performance.
[*] [b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b] - Added and updated gunshot callouts, deactivated cactus collision, and adjusted pedestrian/traffic density across all quality settings.
[*] [b]Medical System Tweaks[/b] - Replaced Epinephrine with Saline in shock treatment, added penalties for untreated patients, and improved diagnosis progression.
[*] [b]New Features[/b] - Introduced an auto-benchmark button to adjust the graphics settings to your PC performance and a Triage Tag Guidance Widget.
[*] [b]UI & Accessibility[/b] - Improved handbook readability, UI scaling, and sound feedback when interacting with menus.
[*] [b]AI & Dialogue[/b] - Reduced repetitive partner dialogue, improved patient conversations, and fixed lip sync issues.
[*] [b]Visual Enhancements[/b] - Lighting improvements, optimized smoke effects, prettier fountain water, and fixed floating objects.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b] - Fixed disappearing bite marks, misplaced NPCs, incorrect animations, and patient repositioning issues.
[*] [b]Collision & Environment Fixes[/b] - Adjusted collisions for trees, traffic lights, wooden planks, and vehicles to prevent glitches.
[*] [b]Crash Fixes[/b] - Addressed crashes related to callouts, menu interactions, and world assets to improve game stability.

notes.title: Performance Status Update
notes.content:
Hello Medics!

First above all, we want to thank you for sharing all your critical feedback with our teams. Ambulance Life is a major milestone for us, and we want it to be just as special for you. [b]We are committed to patching these issues into oblivion.[/b]

⚠️[u][b]An update is coming as soon as it's confirmed and certified, which is most likely late tonight or early tomorrow morning. You will know as soon as we do![/b][/u]

[h3]📝 Submitting Feedback[/h3]
All the tickets you've been submitting to MyNacon has been PIVOTAL in our investigations and solutions for all upcoming. Please continue submitting tickets to the [url=https://my.nacongaming.com/en-GB/support/game/ambulance]MyNacon support portal[/url].

We are constantly listening, collecting, and triaging your reports for immediate action. Our developers are working around the clock to find solutions.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]🛠️ Patch Highlights[/h3]
[list][*] Performance Improvements.
[*]Multiple collisions, visuals and localization bug fixes.
[*]Change of the Guidance Widget about the Triage Tags.
[*]Addition of a score for the application, or not, of life saving measures.
[*]Patient Protocol now shows only tool, diagnoses, and procedures unlocked by the player.
[*]Addition of multiple ambient sounds of the city and modification of the UI's sounds.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
⚠️[b][u]In the meantime, and even after this patch update, players may review the below solutions to significantly improve their performance in most cases.[/u][/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]📁 Purging Existing Configuration File[/h3]
Manually deleting your Ambulance Life configuration settings file will safely allow the game to automatically re-create this file with the recommended settings.

This file can be located here:
[code]C:\Users\NAME\AppData\Local\Sanka\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini[/code]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]💾 Installation Location[/h3]
[u][b]Ambulance Life must be installed to SSD storage to function properly.[/b][/u] Players will see significant performance issues if the game is installed to an HDD.

If you have already installed Ambulance Life to an HDD or an external SSD, Steam allows easy migration of your installation files to another drive of your choice!

Games are installed to the following folder by default:
[code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common[/code]

[b]How do I move a game's installation folder?[/b]
To move a game's installation folder on your computer to a different location on that same computer you can use Steam's "Move" feature. To use this option do the following:
[list][*]Make sure you have a different Steam Library path created to move to (see the instructions in how to add a Steam Library folder above)
[*]Navigate to your Steam client 'Settings' menu.
[*]Open the 'Storage' tab.
[*]Select the drive where the games you wish to move are located.
[*]Select the games you wish to move, and click 'Move'
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/b15e1abc62c523cd28a0f363dd488b03b73c7879.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]🖥️ Enable TSR (Temporal Super Resolution)[/h3]
Enabling TSR in the Anti-Aliasing settings can help improve performance.
[olist]
[*] Go to "Settings"
[*] Navigate to the "Video" tab
[*] Click on "Show Advanced"
[*] Go to "Anti-Aliasing / Super Resolution Method" and scroll through the options to select "TSR"
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/af79ae902546e88a16e4b701964d5765736d523b.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]🖥️ Reduce Traffic & Pedestrian Density[/h3]
These Density options are heavily CPU intensive, but can also directly affect GPU rendering, as well.

In the settings menu, you can adjust the traffic density in San Pelícano.
While a high traffic density adds to realism, it also requires more processing power.
Lowering it can help improve performance on lower-end systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/7b24515b03e3d366a2772312467142cc22e21b0e.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]📨 Contact Support[/h3]
To reiterate, if you are still experiencing issues, please reach out to our support team on the [url=https://my.nacongaming.com/en-GB/support/game/ambulance]MyNacon support portal[/url] with as many details as possible. Your reports help our developers better understand and resolve any problems. ❤️

[hr][/hr]
[h3]⚙️ System Configuration Specifications[/h3]
Make sure your PC meets the [b]minimum, recommended[/b], or [b]optimal system requirements[/b] to run the game as smoothly as possible.

🤏[b]Minimum Specifications[/b]
[list][*] OPERATING SYSTEM: Windows 10
[*]PROCESSOR: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 7 1800X
[*]MEMORY: 16 GB RAM
[*]GRAPHICS: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB or Intel Arc A380, 6 GB

notes.title: Developer Blog #4 | Q&A
notes.content:
Howdy, medics! Troy here with your April Dev Blog update for [b]Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator[/b]!

Our dev team is still face-deep in their monitors plugging away at the game for the release later this year, so we had a different idea for this month’s update! We scoured all the major social media platforms for the [i]frequentest[/i] (definitely a word, don't look it up, just trust me bro) asked questions and tasked the team with getting you some solid and detailed answers!

Without further ado, let’s jump right in!

[hr][/hr]
[b]Q: The jump from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5 must have felt more like a leap. What new tricks did you learn or use with that upgrade.[/b]

[b]A: [/b]With Ambulance Life, we went "all-in" on Unreal Engine 5 and its entire feature set. So, we had to adjust virtually all our systems and established paradigms to adhere to the new workflows. In terms of new tricks, I would say, there was close to no features that didn't provide us with a major learning experience:

[list  ]
[*]Open world building and city generation with a focus on terrain elevation and islands.
[*]Enhanced UI workflows to manage our extremely complex UI framework.
[*]The gameplay ability system, which allows players to interact with the game world.
[*]Mass Crowd and Mass Traffic integration for a living, breathing city simulation. 
[*]Destructible elements of the city’s environment.
[*][b][i]Stunningly[/i][/b] beautiful graphics updates compared to Unreal 4.
[*]Metahumans and Undressing allowed us to build believable patients and NPCs appearances.
[*]We dug deep into rendering "Runtime Virtual Textures" for visualizing the [b][i]many[/i][/b] different symptoms our patients can have.
[*]and so, SO much more!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/5cbb329a0bf554cbb7ef281976d3efa4d032c7fb.png[/img]
 
[b]Q: I imagine there is a tremendous amount of variables when treating patients. Is it actually possible to completely fail shifts in Ambulance Life?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]If you do not treat your patients properly and deliver them in really bad conditions to the hospital, your score will be impacted [b]significantly[/b]. Some instant fail options include running pedestrians over with your vehicle, crashing your ambulance, or you somehow get yourself fatally wounded! Pro tip: Don't stand in fire for long periods of time... ːsteamhappyː

[b]Q: We've  caught some moments of our Paramedics being thrust into unusually-hazardous situations. What was the motivation behind the design decision to break that realism barrier?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]It's about striking the right balance—keeping things realistic yet fun and engaging. That's why we added those high-risk situations to spice up the gameplay and appeal to a wider audience. While real paramedics typically are advised to avoid dangerous or hazardous situations, we wanted to give players a taste of the often unpredictable and perilous nature of the job. These scenarios allow players to experience some of the challenges a first responder might encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/fd9e3a63ee08f7a7c9755187a4ad23c5780d0562.png[/img]

[b]Q: Question: San Pelícano is quite beautiful! What was the most interesting or unique task when designing the city?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]Creating a digital world of that size is always a challenge, technically as well as aesthetically speaking! Even with quickly having a concept for world building and world generation in place, it took a whole lot of iterations for road layouts, building placement, verticality evaluation, district connections, and landscaping as well as many hours of playtesting. We wanted to make sure to settle on the ideal setup, that supports our gameplay and visuals in the best possible way.

One of our core challenges was also to create variety for the different districts, that the players will be able to unlock during the game. We wanted to give each of them a unique and interesting face to explore, while also allowing them to introduce their own driving and navigational challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/8aa7982ac7021f4c208842238b2051355d9d3efb.gif[/img]

[b]Q: Since San Pelícano is based in the United States, will we see more U.S.-based ambulance designs in the final game?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]Yes, absolutely! During the progression of the game the players will be able to unlock multiple different ambulances, which are inspired by both, American and European manufactures seen in paramedic services. We made sure to include some classic looks here!

[b]Q: The Police Simulator: Patrol Officers team used Boston as a model for Brighton City. How did San Francisco become the model for San Pelícano?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]It was clear from the beginning, that we wanted to create another fictional U.S. setting, so we researched possible American cities to draw inspirations from early during production. Along the way, San Francisco really stood out to us as an interesting choice. Some of its features had eminent potential for our game, both as great target visuals as well as interesting challenges for our driving gameplay and callout variety. We were particularly intrigued by the coastal setting, the strong elevation inside the downtown, the vivid nature surroundings, and this unique Californian charm. We wanted to pick up what we loved most about this and bring it towards our own city creation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771459/826c244348a9f5dd687156f16268f2f2122ddfc0.gif[/img]

[b]Q: The content we’ve seen so far showcases a Sprinter-style ambulance type. Will we see more United States-focused models in the future?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]So we wanted to start with something we knew well as a baseline, which is the ambulances one might see right here in Germany. Since the game takes place in the United States, we will definitely feature relevant vehicles for players to choose from. We will have a lot more to share on this later!  

[b]Q: Will Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator feature multi-player functionality?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]Ambulance Life was designed specifically for a robust and complex single-player experience. Now, don’t get us wrong—we LOVE what players have done with the multiplayer features on Police Simulator: Patrol Officers! With how detailed and robust the Callout system is in Ambulance Life, we really wanted to nail the gameplay experience first and foremost.

[hr][/hr]
Thanks for stopping by! Catch us on your favorite social media and be sure to Wishlist [b]Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator[/b] if you haven’t already!

Stay safe and stay alert, medics. See you soon!
-Troy
